code.correct:
def shortest_path(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    dist = [[-1] * m for _ in range(n)]
    q = [(0, 0)]
    dist[0][0] = 0
    head = 0
    dr = (1, -1, 0, 0)
    dc = (0, 0, 1, -1)
    while head < len(q):
        r, c = q[head]
        head += 1
        if r == n - 1 and c == m - 1:
            return dist[r][c]
        for d in range(4):
            nr, nc = r + dr[d], c + dc[d]
            if 0 <= nr < n and 0 <= nc < m and grid[nr][nc] == 0 and dist[nr][nc] == -1:
                dist[nr][nc] = dist[r][c] + 1
                q.append((nr, nc))
    return -1
